_comment: Tier-2 for dune::poisson#5 and dune::poisson_mms#5 — the same two grid objects answer both, so one fixture. Measured on dune-fem 2.12.0.2, 2026-08-06, wall time 2 s (no scheme is built, so nothing JIT-compiles): structuredGrid([0,0],[1,1],[4,4]) -> 16 cells, all 'quadrilateral'; aluConformGrid(cartesianDomain([0,0],[1,1],[4,4])) -> 32 cells, all 'triangle'; P1 dof count 25 on BOTH, which is why the dof count cannot be used to tell the grids apart and the element count can. 3D structuredGrid([0,0,0],[1,1,1],[4,4,4]) -> 64 'hexahedron' cells with lagrange order 1 -> 125 dofs and order 2 -> 729 dofs, i.e. exactly (n*k+1)^3, the identity the poisson_mms cubic-cost cap is derived from.
